_note: model = main session model for local (Mac/Windows) jobs. Heavy work runs in .claude/agents with their own fixed models (designer=fable, developer=opus, tester=sonnet...), in cloud and local jobs alike.

jobs.title: Ideate and write spec with acceptance criteria
jobs.done: automation/spec.md exists, every requirement maps to at least one numbered, testable acceptance criterion (AC-1, AC-2, ...), and the reviewer agent signed off in automation/reviews/spec.md

jobs.title: Design consultancy (Fable)
jobs.done: automation/design/ has a screen-by-screen design spec covering every acceptance criterion that has a UI, with no open design questions left unrecorded

jobs.title: Build iOS app (Opus)
jobs.done: every acceptance criterion is implemented or explicitly deferred in automation/decisions.md, the code compiles in CI or the build check is queued for the mac test job, and the reviewer agent found no blocking issues

jobs.title: Unit + UI tests in the iOS simulator until clean
jobs.done: xcodebuild test on the configured simulator exits 0 on two consecutive runs, and every acceptance criterion in automation/spec.md is covered by at least one test listed in automation/reviews/test-coverage-ios.md

jobs.title: Extract platform-neutral source strings
jobs.done: automation/l10n/strings.source.json contains every user-facing string with a comment for translators, and no hard-coded user-facing strings remain in the iOS code

jobs.title: Translate into all languages (multi-agent)
jobs.done: node automation/tools/check-strings.mjs exits 0 (every language complete, placeholders intact, lengths within limit) and every language has a back-translation review in automation/reviews/l10n/

jobs.title: iOS App Store screenshots per language
Caption screenshots per language
jobs.done: automation/marketing/captions/<lang>.json exists for every language, each caption fits the length limit, and the reviewer agent approved them

jobs.title: Marketing blog in every language
jobs.done: automation/marketing/blog/<lang>.md exists for every language, every feature claim maps to an acceptance criterion, every image path exists, and the post is published or a publish question was raised

jobs.title: App Store release
jobs.done: fastlane precheck passes and the build plus localized metadata and screenshots are uploaded to App Store Connect (submitted for review if approvals.storeSubmission is automatic)

jobs.title: Build Android app in its own repo
jobs.done: every acceptance criterion is implemented or explicitly deferred, ./gradlew assembleDebug succeeds, and translations are exported to res/values-*/strings.xml

jobs.title: Unit + UI tests on the Android emulator until clean
jobs.done: ./gradlew test connectedAndroidTest exits 0 on two consecutive runs and every acceptance criterion is covered by a test listed in automation/reviews/test-coverage-android.md

jobs.title: Google Play release
jobs.done: fastlane supply uploaded the bundle, localized listings and screenshots to the configured track

jobs.title: Forum post drafts (you approve posting)
jobs.done: automation/marketing/forums/<forum>.md exists for every configured forum, each draft follows that forum's rules, and a question asking for posting approval has been raised
